question: What bodily form results from constant yogic practice over time?
premises: The practitioner engages in constant yogic practice.
This practice produces a transformation of appearance.
The resulting form is that of a sixteen-year-old.
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one becomes of the form of a sixteen-year-old.
plain_english: Through the yoga of constant practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
